lines.text: Someone in a rain hat is pouring water into a puddle from a watering can.

lines.speaker: puddle_keeper
lines.text: Careful. Every puddle has to last until morning. That one's mine.

lines.speaker: puddle_keeper
lines.text: And you have very dry slippers. Suspicious.

lines.speaker: puddle_keeper
lines.text: You. My puddles nearly dried because of you.
You fill the watering can at the drain. It glugs.
You tip it into the big puddle. The puddle looks relieved.

lines.speaker: puddle_keeper
lines.text: Wet until morning. Every one. Here, take a little puddle for the road.
You got a jar of puddle.

lines.speaker: puddle_keeper
lines.text: Hmph. The puddles and I are leaving.
The Puddle Keeper sloshes off down the street.

lines.speaker: puddle_keeper
lines.text: Still wet. Still mine. Thanks to you.
A puddle. It's holding very still.
A dry spot where a puddle used to be.
